Pine Cliffs Ocean Suites, a Luxury Colle.name: Pine Cliffs Ocean Suites, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa
Pine Cliffs Ocean Suites, a Luxury Colle.text: Suites and apartments in the same building as the award-winning Serenity Spa, with free access to its Oasis Thermal area. All rooms interconnect, which makes it popular with families. A good choice if a round on Pine Cliffs is one part of a holiday where the spa matters as much as the golf.
perks: Lower green fees for resort guests

PortoBay Blue Ocean.name: PortoBay Blue Ocean
PortoBay Blue Ocean.text: The **highest-rated hotel on this list (9.2 on Booking.com)** sits on the clifftop just west of the resort, a 7-minute drive from the clubhouse. Formerly TUI Blue Falésia, it is not adults-only, but it has a lounge area reserved for adults and a calm, couple-friendly feel. Note that its sister hotel next door, PortoBay Falésia, is closed for refurbishment until May 2027.

WOT Algarve Soul.name: WOT Algarve Soul
WOT Algarve Soul.text: Simple apartments and studios on the Almancil side, rated **8.5 on Booking.com** and from about €54 a night in October, which is rare for this area. It has no golf services of its own, but it's about 6 minutes from the Royal and 10 from the South Course.
WOT Algarve Soul.distanceLabel: Quinta do Lago South about 10 min · Vale do Lobo Royal about 6 min

Vilar do Golf.name: Vilar do Golf
Vilar do Golf.text: Apartments right beside the South Course, two minutes from the clubhouse, rated **8.8 on Booking.com** and from about €103 a night in October. The resort offers a **golf club rental service**, handy if you're travelling light, and every apartment has a kitchen.
Vilar do Golf.distanceLabel: Quinta do Lago South about 2 min · Vale do Lobo Royal about 13 min

Conrad Algarve.name: Conrad Algarve
Conrad Algarve.text: A five-star hotel rated **9.0 on Booking.com**, from about €170 a night in October. Its **golf concierge** can book your rounds, and breakfast starts at 7am, which suits an early tee time. It sits between the two courses, 6 minutes from the South and 8 from the Royal.
perks: Lessons with a PGA golf pro
Signature Quinta do Lago Golf Experience packages
Conrad Algarve.distanceLabel: Quinta do Lago South about 6 min · Vale do Lobo Royal about 8 min

Hilton Vilamoura As Cascatas Golf Resort.name: Hilton Vilamoura As Cascatas Golf Resort & Spa
Hilton Vilamoura As Cascatas Golf Resort.text: A five-star resort overlooking the Pinhal course and one of Vilamoura Golf's official partner hotels, rated **8.5 on Booking.com** and from about €112 a night in October. It's about 5 minutes to the Old Course, and the 7Seven Spa is there for after the round.
Hilton Vilamoura As Cascatas Golf Resort.distanceLabel: Vilamoura Old Course about 5 min · Vilamoura Millennium about 7 min

Vila Vita Parc.name: Vila Vita Parc
Vila Vita Parc.text: A clifftop resort near Porches rated an exceptional **9.5 on Booking.com**, from about €246 a night in October. It's 15 minutes from Salgados and 18 from Amendoeira. Pick it if the weekend is a special occasion rather than just a golf trip.
Vila Vita Parc.distanceLabel: Salgados about 15 min · Amendoeira Faldo about 18 min

Hotel Don Rodrigues.name: Hotel Don Rodrigues
Hotel Don Rodrigues.text: A small hotel rated **8.8 on Booking.com**, from €65 a night **with breakfast** on its own website. It has an outdoor pool and free parking, and it's 12 minutes from Benamor. Breakfast starts at 8am, so for an early tee time ask about something to take with you.
Hotel Don Rodrigues.distanceLabel: Benamor about 12 min · Quinta de Cima about 17 min

OZADI Tavira Hotel.name: OZADI Tavira Hotel
OZADI Tavira Hotel.text: A four-star hotel on the edge of Tavira, rated **9.0 on Booking.com** from more than 3,700 reviews and from about €77 a night in November. It's the closest of the three to Benamor, about 6 minutes away, and has two pools and free parking.
OZADI Tavira Hotel.distanceLabel: Benamor about 6 min · Quinta de Cima about 11 min

Pousada Convento Tavira.name: Pousada Convento Tavira
Pousada Convento Tavira.text: A Pousada in a former 16th-century convent in the centre of Tavira, rated **9.0 on Booking.com** and from €131 a night on its own website. You can walk to the old town's restaurants after the round. Breakfast runs from 8am to 11am.
Pousada Convento Tavira.distanceLabel: Benamor about 13 min · Quinta de Cima about 18 min

Pestana Palm Gardens.name: Pestana Palm Gardens
Pestana Palm Gardens.text: Clifftop studios and apartments in Carvoeiro run by Pestana, the same group that owns Ferragudo. Pestana says guests get **exclusive benefits and discounts at Gramacho and Vale da Pinta**, so it is a smart base if you want to play all three Pestana courses. Breakfast starts at 8am and is charged separately, but every unit has a kitchen, so an early bite before your round is easy.
perks: Discounts at Gramacho and Vale da Pinta

Jupiter Marina Hotel.name: Jupiter Marina Hotel
Jupiter Marina Hotel.text: A stylish hotel on Portimão marina aimed at couples, with a spa, a rooftop bar and a free shuttle to Praia da Rocha beach. It scores **9.0 on Booking.com**, unusually high for the price, and breakfast starts at 7.30am. A good pick for golfing couples who want restaurants and nightlife within walking distance after the round. Parking is paid.

Penina Hotel & Golf Resort.name: Penina Hotel & Golf Resort
Penina Hotel & Golf Resort.text: The Algarve's original golf resort, with three courses on site including the Sir Henry Cotton-designed [Penina Championship](/courses/penina-championship). Penina's "Best Available Rate for Golfers" includes **a complimentary round every day** on one of its courses (a handicap certificate is needed for the Championship course). Combine a few rounds there with a day at Ferragudo, 15 minutes away. Breakfast starts at 7am.
perks: Free daily round on the golfer rate

Tivoli Carvoeiro Algarve Resort.name: Tivoli Carvoeiro Algarve Resort
Tivoli Carvoeiro Algarve Resort.text: A five-star clifftop resort a short walk from Carvoeiro village, with sea views, a full spa and indoor and outdoor pools. It is one of the most established golf-holiday hotels in this area: UK golf tour operators sell packages here that include rounds at Gramacho and Vale da Pinta, and Ferragudo is about 23 minutes away.

Dom José Beach Hotel.name: Dom José Beach Hotel
Dom José Beach Hotel.text: A three-star beach hotel in neighbouring Quarteira that scores an impressive **8.9 on Booking.com** from about €61 a night in October. It has no golf services of its own, but it is about 13 minutes from Pinhal and 15 from the Old Course, and breakfast starts at 7.30am.

Tivoli Marina Vilamoura Algarve Resort.name: Tivoli Marina Vilamoura Algarve Resort
Tivoli Marina Vilamoura Algarve Resort.text: A big five-star resort right between the marina and the beach, rated **8.9 on Booking.com** from more than 1,600 reviews. It suits golfers travelling with non-golfing partners or family, with the beach, pools and marina all on the doorstep. Pinhal is about 11 minutes away and the Old Course about 14.
perks: Right between the marina and the beach

RR Alvor Baía Resort.name: RR Alvor Baía Resort
RR Alvor Baía Resort.text: A large, family-friendly resort of suites with kitchenettes, with a spa, gym and heated hydrotherapy pool. For golfers the useful detail is breakfast: it starts at 7am, and the hotel offers **a breakfast pack for early-morning departures** if you ask at reception the day before, ideal for a first tee time at Penina.

Belavista da Luz.name: Belavista da Luz
Belavista da Luz.text: A four-star wellness hotel in Praia da Luz, rated **8.5 on Booking.com** from more than 1,000 reviews, with a spa. About 8 minutes from Boavista.

Hotel Marina Rio.name: Hotel Marina Rio
Hotel Marina Rio.text: A four-star hotel opposite Lagos marina, a short walk from the old town, rated **9.0 on Booking.com** from more than 1,000 reviews. A private garage is available if you reserve in advance. About 9 minutes from Boavista.

Palmares Beach House Hotel.name: Palmares Beach House Hotel
Palmares Beach House Hotel.text: The five-star boutique hotel on the Palmares resort, adults only, with just 20 rooms including two suites. It scores **8.9 on Booking.com**, and Palmares sells Stay & Play packages that combine a stay with rounds on its 27 holes. Right at Palmares.

Alfagar Village.name: Alfagar Village
Alfagar Village.text: Clifftop apartments above Santa Eulália beach, just three minutes from Balaia and rated 8.8 by guests. It has no golf services of its own, but it is one of the closest and best-value options, with a heated indoor pool and gym for the cooler months, massages on request and a paid airport transfer.
